signature.one_line: Tier-list over one static shot: S-E board in the lower 40 %, icon cards pop to centre then drop into rows; persistent black-box title.
unique_devices: Graphic as the pacing engine: S-E tier board (dark rounded panel x 11.4-87.5 %, y 54.6-92 %, six rows with flat pastel accent-to-second accent label tiles) gets a new white icon card every ~66 frames, so one static shot carries ~93 % of the runtime
Card choreography: rises from below into the centre at ~2x with heavy vertical motion blur (~8 frames), holds until the tier is spoken, then shrinks and flies into its row slot in 2-3 frames

Caption parked in the gap between chin and board (centre 50.2 %): 1-2-word tight-tracked (-0.05em) semibold white, hard cuts, plus a persistent 2-line white-on-black square title box at 7.5-16.8 % height
Clean CTA reset: hard cut to the same framing with every graphic removed for the final ~7 % (save/follow ask)
signature.why_it_works: Title plus empty board explain the format instantly; a verdict lands within a second, the board changes every ~2 seconds, and spicy ratings provoke comments.

hook.type: in medias res + open loop (question title over an empty board)
hook.first_frame: static MCU of the speaker in a warm lamp-lit room, black-box 2-line question title at the top, empty S-E tier board in the lower 40 %, a one-word caption at mid-frame

structure.what: first item named and rated with no intro; title and empty board frame the format
rapid ratings: item, tier, reason of 6 words or fewer; one deliberately spicy low rating
more ratings until the board is nearly full
the last item gets the longest reason as a takeaway
hard cut to a clean shot, save-and-follow ask

pacing.note: only one picture cut; the board event every ~66 frames and 1-2-word caption swaps provide the motion; very dense speech, no pauses

captions.what: 1-2-word white caption between face and board
captions.how: Inter-SemiBold-like 60 px, tracking -0.05em, faint soft shadow, no box; centre x 50 %, y 50.2 %; hard cut on (up to 2 frames early) and off; same spot on the clean CTA shot

background_text.what: persistent 2-line question title on a black box
background_text.how: Inter-Bold-like 70 px, -0.05em, white on solid #060606 square rectangle x 23.2-76.3 %, y 7.5-16.8 %, ~18 px padding; static from frame 0

motion_graphics.what: icon card pop-in and drop into row
motion_graphics.how: rise from below the board to centre at ~2x with vertical motion blur (~8 frames, power3.out), hold, then scale down and fly to its slot in 2-3 frames (power2.in)

cards_lists.how: dark #1A1A17 rounded panel x 11.4-87.5 %, y 54.6-92 %, 6 rows ~6.2 % H; label column to x 25.3 % with flat tiles S #FC7E7E, A #FEBD7E, B #FCDC7F, C #FCFC7F, D #BEFD7F, E #80FE81; white ~9.5 % W icon cards with tiny labels fill left to right

layout.how: face in the upper half, caption at 50 %, board in the lower 40 %

transitions.what: single hard cut to the clean CTA shot
transitions.how: mid-sentence hard cut; all graphics drop out on the cut

end_card.how: same MCU, no title or board, caption only; spoken save/follow ask

case.caption: sentence case following the transcript (capital at a sentence / item start, lower-case mid-sentence)

captions_spec.punctuation: kept; most captions end in a full stop (each list item and verdict is its own sentence)

grouping.sync: one short phrase at a time, replaced as a unit

layout.rule: sits in the gap between the chin and the top of the tier board (board top 54.6 %); stays at the same spot on the final clean CTA shot
layout.on_1080x1920: same 9:16 canvas: centre x 540 px, y 964 px

caption.font_class: neo-grotesque sans, semibold, tight negative tracking (letters nearly touching, Inter-Display / SF-like)
caption.k_note: a capitalised word with ascender and descenders -> k 0.99: 3.05 x 19.2 / 0.99 = 59 px; 'in the' (no descenders, k 0.73): 2.34 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 62 px; render-verified with Inter 600 at -0.05em: 60 px
caption.calibration_note: 'in the' measured over the neck (clean background, --ink #FFFFFF:20); a capitalised one-word item with descenders measured by frame differencing at 3.05 % H
caption.shadow: faint soft dark shadow, ~0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25) at 1920 (estimated)

animation.entry: hard cut, full size on frame 1 (no fade/scale/slide)
animation.timing: on or up to ~2 frames before the transcript word start
animation.exit: hard cut on the next caption

other_text_spec.when: whole main shot (frame 0 to the cut to the CTA shot); removed for the CTA shot
other_text_spec.text: 'Question Title / Goes Here?' 2 centred lines, white #EEEEEE-#FFFFFF, bold tight neo-grotesque (closest Inter 700, tracking ~-0.05em), Title Case
other_text_spec.box: solid black #060606 rectangle, square corners, x 23.2-76.3 % W, y 7.5-16.8 % H; padding ~12 px at 720 (~18 px at 1080) around the text
other_text_spec.position: line 1 ink 8.4-11.2 % H, width ~43 % W; line 2 ink 13.0-15.9 % H, width ~50 % W; line pitch 4.7 % H; each line ink 2.89 % H (k 0.73)
other_text_spec.size: render-fit Inter 700 at -0.05em: 70 px at 1920 (formula 2.89 x 19.2 / 0.73 = 76 px)
other_text_spec.animation: on from frame 0, static, hard-cut out with the picture cut to the CTA shot

other_text_spec.panel: dark #1A1A17 rounded panel, x 11.4-87.5 % W, y 54.6-92.0 % H, 6 equal rows (~6.2 % H each) separated by thin dark lines
other_text_spec.labels: left column x 11.4-25.3 % W, flat colour tiles with a small dark letter: S #FC7E7E, A #FEBD7E, B #FCDC7F, C #FCFC7F, D #BEFD7F, E #80FE81
other_text_spec.items: white rounded icon cards (~9.5 % W square) with an illustrated icon and a tiny dark item label, placed left-to-right in their row
other_text_spec.animation: a new card rises from below the board into the centre at ~2x size with heavy vertical motion blur (~8 frames), holds at centre until the tier is spoken, then shrinks and flies into its row slot in ~2-3 frames; one card every ~66 frames

other_text_spec.text: clean MCU with all graphics removed; only the normal caption remains at the same position

style.look_intent: warm, high-contrast, muted; lamp-lit beige background, soft light, natural skin

sound.music: voice only (no bed detected); very dense speech, no pauses
sfx: soft pop on each card arrival at centre (suggestion)
short whoosh/tick as each card drops into its row (suggestion)
the single cut is unhit (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: rating or ranking a list of items (skills, tools, products, habits) in a short reel
the user has one static talking-head take and needs motion without cutting
a save-worthy summary graphic is the goal (filled board at the end)
the item list can be illustrated with simple icons
avoid_when: the content is a narrative or a single argument, not a list
the speaker's chest/hands must stay visible (the board covers the lower 40 %)
no icons or item assets can be produced
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B26 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B26.json) to this brand.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps (reference 29.97). All positions are % of frame; px are at 1080x1920.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} >= 7:1 on {{CARD_BG}}; the tier ramp must stay a clear hot-to-cool order from {{ACCENT}} (top tier) to {{ACCENT_2}} (bottom tier) with dark letters >= 4.5:1 on each tile)
- {{TEXT}}      captions, title text, icon cards       default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}}    top-tier (S) label tile                default #FC7E7E (A #FEBD7E, B #FCDC7F, C #FCFC7F, D #BEFD7F interpolate)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  bottom-tier (E) label tile             default #80FE81
- {{SURFACE}}   tier board panel                       default #1A1A17
- {{CARD_BG}}   title box                              default #060606
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} title                               default Inter 700 (tight neo-grotesque, -0.05em)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    captions, card labels               default Inter 600 (-0.05em)
- {{HANDLE}}    not shown
- {{LOGO}}      optional small mark inside the board's corner; item icons are the brand's own illustrations

CAPTIONS
1. English as spoken, sentence case as transcribed; keep full stops and other punctuation.
2. 1-2 words per caption, one line, replaced as a unit.
3. Type: {{FONT_BODY}} at 60 px, letter-spacing -0.05em (letters nearly touch), {{TEXT}}, no stroke, no box, faint shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25).
4. Position: centred, centre at 50.2 % of height (y ~964 px), in the gap between the chin and the board top (54.6 %). Same spot on the clean CTA shot.
5. Animation: hard cut in on the word (up to 2 frames early), hard cut out on the next caption. No fade, pop, slide, highlight or idle motion.

OTHER TEXT
6. Persistent title for the whole main shot: 2 centred lines ("Question Title / Goes Here?") in {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 70 px, tracking -0.05em, {{TEXT}}, Title Case, on a solid {{CARD_BG}} square-cornered rectangle x 23-76 %, y 7.5-16.8 % (~18 px padding), line pitch 4.7 % H; on from frame 0, static, removed at the cut to the CTA shot.
7. Tier board: {{SURFACE}} rounded panel x 11.4-87.5 %, y 54.6-92.0 %, six equal rows separated by thin dark lines; left label column (to x 25.3 %) with flat tiles from {{ACCENT}} (S) through A/B/C/D to {{ACCENT_2}} (E), each with a small dark letter. Items are white rounded icon cards (~9.5 % W) with a tiny dark label, placed left to right in their row.
8. Card animation: rise from below the board into the centre at ~2x size with strong vertical motion blur over ~8 frames, hold until the tier is spoken, then shrink and fly into its row slot in 2-3 frames; next card every ~66 frames.
9. CTA: hard cut to the same framing with all graphics removed for the final ~7 %; captions only.

EDIT DEVICES
10. One static MCU for the main shot; no punch-ins. Script cadence: item, tier, reason of 6 words or fewer; include one or two spicy ratings; the last item gets the longest reason.

GRADE
11. Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, high-contrast, muted, lamp-lit, natural skin.

AUDIO
12. Voice only; soft pop on each card arrival and a short tick as it lands in its row. Master to about -14.1 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render a test frame with the caption "in the" over a dark area (not a white shirt) and measure:
   python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test.mp4> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.3,0.47,0.7,0.535 --ink "{{TEXT}}:20"
   Required at the default font: "in the" ink 2.34 % ±0.5 of height and 12.1 % ±2 of width; centre y 50.2 % ±0.5. With a brand font, compute the expected ink with video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py ({{FONT_BODY}}, 60 px, -0.05em).
b) Title: render "KEY WORD" on each line; expected ink 2.89 % H per caps-height line at the default font (or the fit_font.py value for {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 70 px); box edges within ±1 %.
